newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange prices mixed, volume lower.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange prices mixed, volume lower.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange was quieter and prices were mixed on Tuesday as dealers looked for direction from gold rates in world markets.
Volume eased to 737 kg from 781 on Monday and prices dropped to $375.10 an ounce from $376.10.
Gold rose in lira terms, though, to 1,218,900 lira per gram from Monday's 1,216,600, in line with the Turkish currency's weakness versus the dollar.
The lira closed easier at 101,010 to the dollar, after 100,500 on Monday.
The morning session saw 487 kg of trade and the afternoon 250 kg. 68.7 percent of trade was in lira terms.
